description: Prism Runway Show is a Roblox fashion game by LILY & LIFFY where you style an outfit for each show's theme and compete with other players on the runway. Codes unlock free clothing pieces, accessories and sometimes coins.
redeemSteps: Open Prism Runway Show on Roblox and wait until you are in the game.
Click the blue button with three white lines in the top-right corner.
Paste the code into the "Enter Code Here!" box and click Redeem. Codes are case-sensitive, so copy them exactly.
